mission: Deliver one validated NexusCentral application from one source tree, with desktop and web runtime profiles, local-owned user state, routing-only shared model capacity, internal application APIs, and evidence-gated harness execution.
objective: Repair the metadata-driven default contract by resolving ref, commit, and tree from one live remote authority.

acceptedEvidence.claim: Live origin/main commit a79c762 resolves to tree 91e9fd2.

recentFailures.claim: The stale packet resolved tree fd6c6f1 from local refs/heads/main while pinning live commit a79c762.

allowedReads: Live remote HEAD symref and branch SHA
Git object addressed directly by the live SHA
Local origin/HEAD only as an explicitly stale fallback
exclusions: No local branch name may be dereferenced for a live-remote tree pin
No ref, branch, index, worktree, workflow, or source mutation
No fetch, checkout, merge, push, or repository-setting change
No deletion or rewriting of the contradictory revision-24 evidence
acceptanceGate: The contract resolves default by remote metadata rather than assuming the name main.
oneFixPlan: Resolve the live symref, read its advertised SHA, derive the tree from that SHA object, assert commit-tree coherence, and rerun renamed/default/fallback fixtures.
validationCommand: Re-read live metadata; verify commit^{tree}, local-stale contrast, fixtures, packet digests, and zero Git mutation twice.
cancellationRule: Stop if live SHA is unavailable locally or differs from local tracking; fetching is forbidden in this leaf.
